frame.axes: x east, y north (72 x 72 plate), z_aff above the level's finished floor; z_abs = elevation_ft + z_aff
frame.three_js_world: metres: [x * 0.3048, z_abs * 0.3048, -y * 0.3048] (the canonical viewers load each GLB with rotation.x = -PI/2)

ticket.title: The network closet suddenly went dark
ticket.role: You are responding to a building-wide support escalation.
ticket.issue_report: Equipment served by a basement network closet dropped offline at the same time.
ticket.goal: Trace the shared power dependency, restore the simulated path, and verify network equipment recovers.
known: Several devices failing together can point to a shared dependency.
Check power before treating each endpoint as an unrelated failure.
ticket.success_message: The shared network equipment is back because you repaired the common power dependency instead of treating every endpoint separately.

ticket.title: The check-in computer has no internet
ticket.role: You are the junior IT technician on duty.
ticket.issue_report: The check-in computer was working earlier. Now it says it has no network connection.
ticket.goal: Find the smallest cause, make the safest repair, and prove the computer is back online.
known: The problem was reported from one workstation.
Do not change unrelated systems just to make the symptom disappear.
ticket.success_message: Reception can use the check-in computer again, and you verified the fix instead of stopping at the first green light.

ticket.title: The Wi-Fi on Floor 2 stopped working
ticket.role: You are the junior IT technician responding to a user report.
ticket.issue_report: People in the forum suddenly cannot connect to Wi-Fi. Wired systems in the room are still expected to work.
ticket.goal: Determine why the local Wi-Fi disappeared, restore it safely, and verify clients can reconnect.
known: Start with what users can observe before opening an engineering view.
A wireless access point needs both a network link and power.
ticket.success_message: Floor 2 Wi-Fi is available again. The repair addressed the access point path without changing unrelated network services.

ticket.title: The interview-room phone will not connect
ticket.role: You are supporting a staff member before an interview.
ticket.issue_report: The desk phone has power, but it will not register for calls.
ticket.goal: Find why the phone cannot register, repair the assignment, and verify calling service returns.
known: Power alone does not prove the phone is on the correct voice network.
Avoid broad network changes when one endpoint is affected.
ticket.success_message: The phone registers again and the change stayed limited to the affected voice path.

F4.title: Floor 4 Media Production AV QoS Degradation

ticket.title: The media floor video is choppy
ticket.role: You are supporting a media-production session.
ticket.issue_report: The video path is showing loss and jitter even though the endpoints are still online.
ticket.goal: Find why real-time media lost priority, restore the expected treatment, and verify smooth delivery.
known: This is a quality problem, not a total outage.
Compare the capture and control path before changing anything.
ticket.success_message: The production path is stable again and the fix targeted traffic handling rather than masking the symptom.

ticket.title: A research computer is on the wrong network
ticket.role: You are supporting a policy/research workstation.
ticket.issue_report: The computer is connected, but it is reaching the wrong network resources.
ticket.goal: Identify the assignment mismatch, restore the intended network, and verify appropriate access.
known: Connectivity by itself is not proof of correct segmentation.
Do not broaden access as a shortcut.
ticket.success_message: The research workstation is back on the intended network without broadening permissions.

ticket.title: A command-floor camera stopped sending video
ticket.role: You are troubleshooting a building security video problem.
ticket.issue_report: One camera no longer reaches the video system.
ticket.goal: Trace the broken path, restore the simulated link, and verify video reaches the recorder again.
known: A camera depends on power, network connectivity and the recording service.
Start at the symptom and follow the dependency chain.
ticket.success_message: The camera feed is restored to the video system and the dependency path has been verified.

ticket.title: The rooftop controls stopped reporting
ticket.role: You are supporting building operations in a training sandbox.
ticket.issue_report: Roof equipment is still physically present, but its building-control telemetry disappeared.
ticket.goal: Trace the control problem, restore the simulated controller, and verify telemetry returns.
known: The controller and its sensor chain are related.
This is a simulation; never infer permission to operate a real BAS from this lab.
ticket.success_message: Rooftop telemetry is back in the sandbox and the repair stayed inside the building-control simulation.
